title: Talent card with 'Get in Touch' arrow bar: white card and full-bleed green gradient card

observed.layout: Left: white card with a rounded green gradient banner, an illustrated avatar on a cream circle overlapping the banner, name 'Olivia Rhye', handle '@Oliviar_', a black 'Follow' pill and a bookmark icon button, a divider, a three-stat row with icons (star 4.9 Rating, document 125 Posts, person 12.4K Followers), and a full-width black-to-grey gradient bar 'Get in Touch' with a white circle arrow at its left. Right: full-bleed green gradient card with the same content; Follow is an outlined pill, bookmark is filled, stats are white, and 'Get in Touch' is a white pill with a black arrow circle.
observed.hierarchy: Stat numbers are the largest text; the CTA bar is the widest element.
observed.typography: Geometric grotesk; larger stat values than the name. Unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Solid glyphs beside stats; outline bookmark.
observed.materials: Left: flat white with gradient banner. Right: mesh-like green gradient with subtle grain.

interpretation.aesthetic: Fresh, friendly talent card in two skins.
implementation_notes: Skins from one token set: surface, text and CTA colors flip.
Arrow circle is a leading icon inside the CTA.
Green mesh: layered radial gradients, optionally with noise.

concept_work.essence: A talent card whose full-bleed skin trades legibility for atmosphere.
what_makes_it_work: The CTA treatment inverts between skins correctly.
gaps_to_make_it_work: On the green skin, the handle and stat labels measure about 1.8-2.6:1 and the Follow label about 3.1:1.
The left CTA's gradient lightens toward the right, so the label must stay on the dark part.
Two prominent black actions (Follow and Get in Touch) compete.

links: The stat row leads into the CTA, so proof precedes the ask.
Both skins keep the same structure so users learn it once.

approach: Mesh gradient with layered radial gradients

pattern.name: Two skins from one token set (light card vs full-bleed gradient)
use_when: Talent or creator cards that need both a clean and an expressive look
avoid_when: The gradient skin cannot guarantee text contrast
adaptation_examples: Coach directory: green becomes the brand hue, Follow replaced by Book.
Dark mode: use the full-bleed skin with a darker gradient and a scrim.
failure_modes: White text on mid-green under 3:1 for small labels

lessons: A full-bleed gradient skin needs a scrim or a solid panel behind small text.
Avoid two equally heavy actions on the same card.

related.relation: same component family (talent card with stat row and contact CTA)

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: black Follow pill and CTA bar (sampled)
measured.color_roles: Neutral page, green as the full-bleed skin, black for actions on the white card, white for actions on the green card.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A contact-a-creator card with clear information order.
Balanced, readable composition; the white skin is crisp and the green skin is atmospheric.
Stat labels are explicit and the CTA inverts correctly between skins.
Two black actions compete and the bookmark is unlabeled; no follow/hover states.
Both skins share structure, radii and icon treatment.
Familiar talent-card pattern with a nice arrow-bar CTA.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 3.12:1; secondary text min 1.75:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
